findings.claim: New in this correction: the no-JavaScript reading version of the Activity 3 starter (noscript[data-pep-no-js] pre > code after "Starter, Coin.java:") contains a literal backslash-n. Line 486 is `    // 1. Give each constant its value in cents:\n    //    1, 5, 10, 25.`, and with JavaScript off Chromium renders that one line as `// 1. Give each constant its value in cents:\n    //    1, 5, 10, 25.` The editor starter (window.PEP_PAGE.acts[2].starter) has a real line break there, so the reading version no longer matches the editor. The text is still inside one // comment, so code copied from it still compiles (JLS SE 25 3.7), hence low; the other four rewrapped pages' reading versions match their editor starters exactly.
findings.recommendation: Replace the two characters \n on line 486 with a real line break, so the noscript starter reads `    // 1. Give each constant its value in cents:` then `    //    1, 5, 10, 25.` on two lines, as in the editor starter.
